acquisition_note: Extracted mechanically by script from TMIW's literal TestPair list, not retyped. Plan 5.1's correction makes acquisition a property of a corpus, and this one transcribes directly.
corroboration: TMIW issue #462 official-app HCI captures of physical Life Fitness equipment at Google I/O 2024 observed 0x2AD0 notification lengths [19, 20]. Every case below records physicallyConfirmedLength against that set. This is what raises the Phase 6 measurement path above single-source: the vectors come from TMIW, and an independent physical capture says those packet shapes are what real machines emit. See docs/evidence/phase-6/2024-05-15-life-fitness-tmiw-multi-persona-hci.md.
corroborationLimit: A case whose physicallyConfirmedLength is false is NOT discredited -- it is a different flag combination carrying one more or fewer optional field, which a machine with a different feature set would legitimately emit. It is simply TMIW-only evidence, tier 1, and must not be described as physically observed. The four I/O 2024 machines are four machines, not the product line.
